licenses.termBy: Name of the Creative Commons "Attribution" license element (reusers must credit the author). Joined with the other elements of the license to form its name, e.g. "Attribution-ShareAlike"
licenses.termNc: Name of the Creative Commons "NonCommercial" license element (no commercial use). Joined with the other elements of the license to form its name, e.g. "Attribution-NonCommercial"
licenses.termNd: Name of the Creative Commons "NoDerivatives" license element (no modified versions). Joined with the other elements of the license to form its name, e.g. "Attribution-NoDerivatives"
licenses.termSa: Name of the Creative Commons "ShareAlike" license element (derivatives must use the same license). Joined with the other elements of the license to form its name, e.g. "Attribution-ShareAlike"
licenses.termSeparator: Text placed between the elements of a Creative Commons license name, e.g. the hyphen in "Attribution-ShareAlike"
licenses.ccName: Name of a versioned Creative Commons license, followed in the interface by its short code such as "(CC BY-SA 3.0)". Parameters: {terms} - license elements joined by the separator, e.g. "Attribution-ShareAlike", {version} - license version, e.g. "3.0"
licenses.ccNameUnversioned: Name of a Creative Commons license whose version is not known, followed in the interface by its short code such as "(CC BY-SA)". Parameters: {terms} - license elements joined by the separator, e.g. "Attribution-ShareAlike"
licenses.cc0Name: Name of the Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal public domain dedication
